## Comments near the code
- BookingService.handlePaymentResult: Applies a PuckPay payment result. Idempotent; late payments do not revive released bookings.
- SessionService.effectiveCapacity: Club bookings overlapping the session take half the rink (half capacity) or all of it (zero).
- ClubBookingService.invoice: Monthly invoice: every booked hour (whole or half rink) at the club rate.
- ReportService: Aggregates sales figures per session; one pass over the bookings of the sessions in range.
- ReportService.weekly: Report for the 7 days starting at weekStart, or for an explicit from/to range.
- IceMonitorService: Watches the ice temperature and puts the next session on hold when the ice stays too warm.
- IceMonitorService.release: Manager releases a held session: ticket sales resume.
- IceMonitorService.cancel: Manager cancels a held session: every ticket is refunded through PuckPay.
- IceMonitorService.nextSession: The earliest session that has not started yet and is not cancelled.

capabilities.description: Customers book places on public skating sessions: requests are validated, skate hire and membership free-entry rules are enforced, session capacity is checked, bookings are priced and checked out, payment results are applied idempotently, and unpaid bookings expire.
capabilities.name: Public skating ticket booking and payment

capabilities.description: Staff schedule skating sessions, and the business publishes them with their current availability. Overlapping club rink bookings reduce the capacity.
capabilities.name: Skating session scheduling and availability

capabilities.description: Clubs book the whole rink or half of it with no overlapping bookings allowed, and each month they are invoiced for every booked hour at the club rate.
capabilities.name: Club rink hire and monthly invoicing

capabilities.description: Management gets sales figures per session and report-wide totals for a week or an explicit date range.
capabilities.name: Weekly sales reporting

capabilities.description: The ice temperature is watched, and the next session is put on hold when the ice stays too warm, with ticket holders notified. Managers can then release the session or cancel it with full refunds.
capabilities.name: Ice condition monitoring and session hold management
